title: Self-supervised Pretraining of Cell Segmentation Models (DINOCell)
mechanism: Continue DINOv2 ViT-B self-distillation (DINO + iBOT) on 130k domain images with patch size cut from 14 to 8, then a light upsampling decoder.
adaptation: Patch 8 at 512 px gives 64x64 tokens, closer to crack scale; continue DINOv2 ViT-B/8 on the de-duplicated 11.9k pool, 30 epochs at 448; judge on E1 and folds.
min_experiment: Arm: continued ViT-B/8. Baseline: ViT-B/8 from DINOv2 without continuation, same decoder. Kill if E1 crack recall < +0.02.
evidence: R: LIVECell SEG 0.784, +10.42% over SAM-based models; but continued domain SSL changed little vs DINOv2 init (+6.48% on 1 of 4 sets); ~100 h on 8 L40S.

alt_notes.adaptation: Patch 8 at 512 px gives 64x64 tokens; continue on the de-duplicated pool; judge on E1 and folds.
alt_notes.min_experiment: ViT-B/8 continued on 11.9k vs without continuation; kill if E1 crack recall < +0.02. Only if NeCo or MedDINOv3 shows a sign.
